uncertainty: Twenty pinned open-source Maven package paths passed the valid ASCII P3 2x1 red/green PPM control through local input APIs. Eleven paths returned both pixel values; Tika returned dimensions, JavaCV decoded a frame and returned codec/dimensions, and seven FFmpeg or FFprobe binding/wrapper paths returned format or codec/dimensions. Apache Commons Imaging, TwelveMonkeys, JAI ImageIO, and ImageJ have PNM readers. Thumbnailator, BoofCV, Tika, and IJ Plugins ImageIO rely on installed PNM ImageIO providers; OpenPnP uses native OpenCV. The Lafa ImageIO plugin is a TwelveMonkeys fork. The imageio-native-vips and imageio-native-magick paths use host libvips or ImageMagick. JavaCV, Bytedeco FFmpeg, Jaffree, bramp FFmpeg, v47 Jaffree, Imagic FFmpeg Java, and JAVE2 share FFmpeg's PPM decoder; the v47 and Imagic packages are forks of Jaffree and bramp. Four wrappers invoke pinned-hash host FFprobe, and im4java invokes pinned-hash ImageMagick identify. Six bounded Maven Central queries saved 12 hits and 12 unique names; broad pnm, ppm, and portable anymap queries timed out. Targeted official project documentation supplied additional format-specific leads. One ImageIO plugin project remains unresolved. The JDK 21 official ImageIO reader list omits PNM; a bare-JDK control probe found no PNM reader. Only ASCII P3 PPM was demonstrated; PBM, PGM, PAM, and binary PNM are not implied. The 20-path working target is met, but timed-out registry searches and the unresolved lead mean these are not established as an exhaustive top 20. deps.dev exact-release direct dependents are only a partial within-Java adoption proxy.
